taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: >59.3 m (top of the low‑resistivity layer 5, likely saturated sands/clayey sand)
Recommendation: Target drilling beyond 59.3 m to intersect the productive layer 5 zone, extending at least 15–20 m into it for adequate screen length; case off the overlying high‑resistivity layers (2.78–59.3 m) to prevent collapse and cross‑contamination, and run water quality tests given the relatively low resistivity (178 Ω·m) which may indicate fine‑grained or saline-influenced material.
